reviews.title: I recommend getting
reviews.text:
I absolutely recommend getting the game graphics and movement is just amazing there aren’t many ads unless you want ads. Great gameplay it’s easy but also challenging and that’s why this game deserves a 5 star rating cause this game is beautiful and addicting it’s   satisfying that’s another reason you should get it but there are some bug issues. 

1. This one isn’t a bug but it’s kinda a problem. When you get a glider and you go through the finish line to hit the diamonds you can still control the glider and that’s super OP cause you can control the glider as far as you want and that kinda needs to get fixed I don’t know if this was intended or not but you have to fix it. 

2. The gliders sometimes are a little buggy sometimes one time I picked one up and my game kinda glitched a little but otherwise it’s not that much of a deal. 

Otherwise that’s pretty much it the devs need All the support and love because this is a game that changed my life thank you so much if you read this cause this is the greatest game I have (along with Minecraft and Roblox) have a good day

reviews.title: Could use some more hook skins, but still very entertaining! 🌟
reviews.text: I’ve had this game for a while now, and have been wondering if we’re ever going to get some new grappling hook skins. It seems pretty odd to think that this game only has six different hook skins, yet can still keep the tittle “swing loops”? Yeah! But other than that, great game! I highly enjoy playing it & I hope that some other people can give it around as much respect that I did! Very well done!! 👌🤩🌟
